en.title: E-commerce Admin – A&A Parts
en.description: Managed daily operations of an online store independently and monitored sales performance through the e-commerce platform dashboard.

list.title: Key Responsibilities:
items: Managed over 60 product listings.
Handled more than 50 customers and transaction processes.
Monitored order and inventory data to ensure smooth operations.

id.title: Admin Toko Online – A&A Parts
id.description: Mengelola operasional toko online secara mandiri dan memantau performa penjualan melalui dashboard platform e-commerce.

list.title: Peran dan Tanggung Jawab Utama:
items: Mengelola lebih dari 60 listing produk.
Menangani lebih dari 50 pelanggan dan proses transaksi.
Memantau data pesanan dan stok untuk kelancaran operasional.

en.title: Microsoft Excel Trainer (Campus Community Service)
en.description: Delivered basic data processing training using Microsoft Excel to 19 students.

list.title: Key Responsibilities:
items: Developed training materials that were clear and relevant.
Taught basic formulas and fundamental data processing techniques.
Conducted interactive, hands-on training sessions.
Assisted participants in understanding and applying basic Excel concepts.
Prepared activity reports and documentation.

id.title: Trainer Microsoft Excel (PKM Kampus)
id.description: Memberikan pelatihan dasar pengolahan data menggunakan Microsoft Excel kepada 19 siswa.

list.title: Peran dan Tanggung Jawab Utama:
items: Menyusun materi pelatihan yang mudah dipahami dan relevan.
Mengajarkan penggunaan formula dan pengolahan data dasar.
Melakukan sesi pelatihan secara langsung dan interaktif.
Membantu peserta dalam memahami dan menerapkan konsep dasar Excel.
Menyusun laporan hasil kegiatan.

en.title: AI & Data Trainee – AI 4 Jobs (MSIB Batch 6)
en.description: Contributed to the development of a web-based chatbot and performed data processing and dataset preparation to support the implementation of a text classification model using Python.

list.title: Key Responsibilities:
items: Performed data preprocessing including cleaning, tokenization, and encoding on text datasets.
Adapted and implemented text classification models based on project requirements.
Prepared and fine-tuned datasets and model parameters prior to training.
Integrated the model into a web application using Flask.
Developed and implemented the frontend interface for the chatbot system.

en.institution: PT Orbit Ventura Indonesia (Orbit Future Academy)

id.title: AI & Data Trainee – AI 4 Jobs (MSIB Batch 6)
